p.s: Dear Madam,
At first, I want to say how I am happy to have won this prize and I want to thank you.
Concerning the information you want I will give them.
I would like to travel on July because this is the only month given to me by my employer.
I would prefer to have a log cabin because I can not sleep in a tent (it is too hot and the floor is too hard for my back).
Concerning the two activities I have to choose, I would prefer to swim and play tennis (I have a good level in each sports).
Finally
I would like to know how much money I have to prepare and which sorts of clothes are usually weared in California.
Yours faithfully
Pablo Fernandez
